label: 八重神子 · 模型适配

retarget.method: Original mesh proportions preserved by a single uniform transform; independent source-length display skeleton follows original AMB/POS rotations; display weapon sockets follow the new hands.
retarget.fingerArticulation: Thumb and index chains of the native rig drive source finger groups; other fingers fold into those chains.

provenance.credit: 模型提供：miHoYo；模型改造：观海（BiliBili：观海子）。
provenance.license: Original distribution readme retained verbatim. It forbids redistribution, part extraction and commercial use; this is a user-requested local adaptation, not a rights grant or published distribution.
limits: Original source proportions preserved; action retarget remains approximate.
Source PMX has no verified real-world centimetre calibration; no physical height is claimed.
Source hair skeleton and weights retained but MMD rigid bodies are not executed.
Skirt folds follow their source parent body region; sleeves and attached tassels follow the arm; no cloth solver.
No expression morph or independent per-finger solver.
Original toon ramp and sphere-map lighting are not reproduced; original base colour, transparent hair highlight passes, alpha cutout and roughness are used.
